scripts.text:
{0}
Hey, I remember you! I already told you that you may only complete this quest once.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嘿，我记得你！我已经告诉过你了，这个任务只能完成一次。

scripts.text:
{0}
Greeting, lad. I found a really nifty item while I was picking mushrooms near Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你好啊，年轻人。我在格拉斯特海姆附近采蘑菇的时候，发现了一件非常不错的物品。

scripts.text:
{0}
I have never seen an item like this before. I am told it can be placed inside any accessory with a slot available.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我从没见过这样的物品。据说它可以镶嵌在任何有空槽的饰品上。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you're interested in this item, I'll tell you what you need for me to make you one of your own. I can only give one of these to each player, so once you finish this quest, you may not do it again.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果你对这件物品感兴趣，我可以告诉你我需要你提供什么材料才能为你制作一个。我只能给每位玩家一个，所以一旦你完成了这个任务，就不能再做了。

scripts.text: Nah, I don't care about it

{0}
I believe the item is called a ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000. It makes you cast spells really fast!
scripts.translation:
{0}
我想这件物品叫做^FF0000贝泽布卜卡^000000。它能让你施法速度变得非常快！

scripts.text:
{0}
I need all of the following items:

{0}
You lie! Get out of here and get those items, you sorry excuse for a rock star.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你在撒谎！快滚，去把那些物品弄来，你这个一无是处的废物。

scripts.text:
{0}
Congratulations! You have all the items. Here is your ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000, as promised.
scripts.translation:
{0}
恭喜！你集齐了所有物品。这是答应给你的^FF0000贝泽布卜卡^000000。

scripts.text:
{0}
Such a great item I have right here...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我手里正好有这么一件好东西...
